326	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
327	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.

330	           "per-sample smem (~184KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
331	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");

351	//  R2.3 driver). Compiled only under the wgmma token; the scalar path above is
352	//  untouched. The TC path's per-CTA tile scratch lives in HBM (NOT dynamic smem)
353	//  — the only smem the TC kernel needs is the tiny wgmma staging arena (one
354	//  A(64×16) + one B(N×16) bf16 tile + a 256-float reduction + the 10 dW specs),
355	//  which is STATIC (≈ 7 KB), so this kernel — unlike the scalar ViT one — needs
356	//  NO dynamic-smem opt-in. The big ViT activation footprint (which forced the
357	//  scalar path to 184 KB dynamic smem) becomes HBM acts here (Fork B), so the
358	//  occupancy story is the decoder TC one: static smem, 0 dynamic.

362	// TC megakernel threads: 256 (the engine's producer+consumer warpgroup layout;
363	// wgmma is warpgroup-scoped on threads 0..127). We do NOT apply the scalar
364	// path's asymmetric setmaxnreg (it would STARVE the MMA warpgroup); the
365	// validated selftest ran no split. We match it.
366	#define SG_VIT_TC_MEGA_BLOCK 256

368	// ── smem arena for the unpipelined engine. The M-atom-interleaved wgmma pipeline
369	//    (task #24, decoder H1+H3 port) stages kVitAtomsPerSlot A(64×16) tiles per
370	//    k-step (one per stacked m64 atom in an interleave GROUP, issued back-to-back
371	//    into independent fp32 fragments so the tensor pipe overlaps them; atom-in-
372	//    group ai at sA + ai·kVitTcSmemA1) + ONE shared B(N×16) tile. kVitAtomsPerSlot
373	//    = kVitMaxIL (the interleave cap, default 2). Plus the 256-float reduction slot
374	//    + the 10 dW specs (identical for all threads → shared, not per-thread stack).
375	//    16B-aligned. N = SG_TUNED_TILE_N. ──
376	struct VitTcSmem {
377	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[vittc::kVitAtomsPerSlot * 64 * 16];
378	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
379	    float red[256];
380	    vittc::VitDwSpec spec[10];
381	};

383	// ── TC workspace layout (carved from in.workspace; the host sizes it). Regions
384	//    (float units):
385	//      [0 .. acts_f)                      : VitActs bf16 region (reinterpreted)
386	//      [acts_f .. acts_f + nCTA*scratch)  : per-CTA tile scratch (f32)
387	//      [.. + nCTA*kLnVecElems)            : per-CTA LN-vec partials (f32)
388	//      [.. + nCTA)                        : per-CTA loss slots (f32)
389	//      [.. + 1)                           : reduced scalar loss (host reads it)
390	//    acts_f = ceil(acts_bf16 / 2). ──
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_acts_floats(int T, int B) {
392	    return (vittc::vit_acts_bf16_count(T, B) + 1) / 2;
393	}
394	// dW split-K partial floats (0 when G==1 → no extra scratch, the single-CTA path).
395	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_dw_part_floats() {
396	    return vittc::vit_dw_part_floats(vittc::kVitDwSplitK);
397	}
398	// The d-scaled BENCH layout (SG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT=1) is adamw-ONLY (vit_bench.py /
399	// scripts/roofline_bench.py drive OptId::AdamW exclusively — none of the four staged
400	// optimizers ever runs in the bench TU), so carving them there is pure dead weight.
401	// At bench width the SG2 region in particular is pathological: vit_sg2_ws_stride_floats()
402	// is O(Nmax·d_model) PER CTA and Nmax=4d²·… grows with d ⇒ ~565 GB over 132 CTAs at
403	// d=2048, OOMing the 80 GB H100 (the SAME deep limit the decoder twin documents at
404	// dec_tc_sg2_floats — SG2's per-CTA workspace DESIGN doesn't scale; a chunked/streamed
405	// restructure is the documented deep item, out of scope here). So we GATE the four
406	// regions OFF at bench width: honest scoping (the bench never touches them), NOT
407	// correctness suppression. PRODUCTION is byte-identical — kVitStagedOptScratch is true
408	// there, so every gated helper folds back to its original value (constexpr bool, -O3
409	// inline). This mirrors the decoder's kDecStagedOptScratch (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh).
410	#if SG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT
411	constexpr bool kVitStagedOptScratch = false;   // bench: adamw-only → elide the 4 staged-opt carves
412	#else
413	constexpr bool kVitStagedOptScratch = true;    // production: carve all 4 (opt-agnostic launcher)
414	#endif
415	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). The Prodigy
416	// stage publishes per-CTA (r,s) slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d slot (1) — an owner-
417	// computes tree (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST
418	// nCTA (one CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 floats) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so
419	// the opt-agnostic launcher allocates one workspace fitting every OptId. Unused by
420	// AdamW/Lion/… (their P3 never touches it) → those cells stay byte-identical.
421	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
422	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;     // bench (adamw-only): Prodigy never runs
423	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
424	}
425	// ── Muon (STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz) per-matrix scratch. The NS chain
426	//    runs ONE 2D weight at a time over all CTAs; the scratch holds X/A/AX/AAX/orth
427	//    for the LARGEST 2D weight + the per-CTA Frobenius-norm partials + inv_norm. The
428	//    momentum buffer (muon_buf) is NOT here — it PERSISTS across steps as optimizer
429	//    state, bound to the m slice (st.exp_avg). Largest vit 2D weight: ff0/ff2 = 512×
430	//    128 = 65536 numel; largest rows = 512 ⇒ A = 512×512. Carved UNCONDITIONALLY
431	//    (≈ 4·65536 + 512² + nCTA + 1 floats ≈ 2 MB) so the opt-agnostic launcher fits
432	//    every OptId; unused by every non-Muon cell (byte-identical). ──
433	//    kVitMuonMaxNumel = max over 2D weights of rows*cols; kVitMuonMaxRows = max rows.
434	static constexpr int kVitMuonMaxNumel = vit::kDff * vit::kD;     // 512*128 = 65536 (ff0/ff2)
435	static constexpr int kVitMuonMaxRows  = vit::kDff;               // 512 (ff0 rows)
436	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_muon_floats(int nCTA) {
437	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;     // bench (adamw-only): Muon never runs
438	    // X + AX + AAX + orth (each maxNumel) + A (maxRows²) + nrm_partials(nCTA) + inv_norm(1)
439	    return (int64_t)4 * kVitMuonMaxNumel
440	         + (int64_t)kVitMuonMaxRows * kVitMuonMaxRows
441	         + nCTA + 1;
442	}
443	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the ViT twin of
444	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh). The SAM step
445	//    perturbs p in place, runs a SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for
446	//    the exact restore (eager clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-
447	//    reversible, so save — don't subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so
448	//    the 2nd backward does NOT clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad
449	//    reads both). Both are total-sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir
450	//    itself persists in the `extra` state slice, bound by the cell). Carved
451	//    UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kVitTotalElems ≈ 3.3 MB) so the opt-agnostic launcher fits
452	//    every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd
453	//    out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc,
454	//    as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so no extra here. ──
455	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_looksam_floats() {
456	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;      // bench (adamw-only): LookSAM never runs
457	    return (int64_t)2 * kVitTotalElems;       // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
458	}
459	// ── SuperGrok2 — the ViT twin of dec_tc_sg2_floats. Weights from HBM; the only SG2
460	//    workspace is the per-CTA meta-net scratch (sized for the largest tensor) + the
461	//    row_off64 staging prefix (kVitNumTensors int64 = 2*N floats — the adapter that
462	//    builds SG2State.row_off (const int64_t*) from __constant__ int kVitOffsets). ──
463	using VitSG2Dims = SG2Dims<>;
464	// max(kVitSizes), re-derived from the layout table (vit_layout.cuh) so the SAME SG2
465	// tail is correctly sized at ANY ladder width — was a d=128-pinned 65536.
466	constexpr int kVitSG2Nmax = kVitMaxTensorNumel;   // == vit_layout_check::max_size()
467	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_sg2_ws_stride_floats() {
468	    return (int64_t)2 * kVitNumTensors
469	         + sg2_ws_stride<VitSG2Dims>((int64_t)kVitSG2Nmax);
470	}
471	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_sg2_floats(int nCTA) {
472	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;     // bench (adamw-only): SG2 never runs — and
473	        // its honestly-derived per-CTA stride (O(Nmax·d_model)) would OOM at large d.
474	    // +1 for the 8-byte realignment slack of sg2_ws_base (kVitTotalElems is odd).
475	    return (int64_t)nCTA * vit_sg2_ws_stride_floats() + 1;
476	}
477	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int B, int nCTA) {
478	    return vit_tc_acts_floats(T, B)
479	         + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::vit_tile_scratch_total_f32()
480	         + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::kLnVecElems
481	         + nCTA + 1
482	         + vit_tc_dw_part_floats()           // split-K dW partials (G>1)
483	         + vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
484	         + vit_tc_muon_floats(nCTA)          // STAGED-opt (Muon) NS per-matrix scratch
485	         + vit_tc_looksam_floats()           // STAGED-opt (LookSAM) SAM 2nd-bwd scratch
486	         + vit_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA);          // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch (carve-LAST)
487	}

500	template <OptId Opt>
501	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_VIT_TC_MEGA_BLOCK)
502	fused_vit_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
503	                        float* __restrict__ params,
504	                        ViTInputCtx in,
505	                        float* __restrict__ grad,
506	                        float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
507	    __shared__ VitTcSmem sm;
508	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
509	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
510	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
511	    const int B = in.B;
512	    const int T = B * vit::kSeq;
513	    const int Tp = B * vit::kNPatch;
514	
515	    // Workspace partition.
516	    float* ws = in.workspace;
517	    const int64_t acts_f = vit_tc_acts_floats(T, B);
518	    __nv_bfloat16* acts_base = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(ws);
519	    float* scratch_base = ws + acts_f;
520	    const int64_t scratch_per = vittc::vit_tile_scratch_total_f32();
521	    float* lnvec_base = scratch_base + (int64_t)nCTA * scratch_per;
522	    float* loss_part  = lnvec_base + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::kLnVecElems;
523	    float* loss_out   = loss_part + nCTA;
524	    // Split-K dW partials (G>1): the (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles, carved AFTER the
525	    // loss slot (matches vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). G==1 → dw_part unused.
526	    float* dw_part    = loss_out + 1;
527	    const int kDwG    = vittc::kVitDwSplitK;
528	    // STAGED-opt cross-CTA reduce slots (Prodigy d), carved AFTER the dW partials
529	    // (matches vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). Unused unless Opt==Prodigy.
530	    float* opt_reduce = dw_part + vit_tc_dw_part_floats();
531	    // Muon NS per-matrix scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (matches
532	    // vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). Unused unless Opt==Muon. Layout:
533	    //   [muon_X | muon_AX | muon_AAX | muon_orth] (each kVitMuonMaxNumel)
534	    //   [muon_A (kVitMuonMaxRows²)] [nrm_partials (nCTA)] [inv_norm (1)]
535	    float* muon_base = opt_reduce + vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
536	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Muon scratch (term order
537	    // matches vit_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST keeps every prior region's
538	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical). Layout:
539	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
540	    float* sam_backup = muon_base + vit_tc_muon_floats(nCTA);
541	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kVitTotalElems;
542	    // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch, carved AFTER the LookSAM sam_grad (term
543	    // order matches vit_tc_workspace_floats — carve-LAST keeps every prior region's
544	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical). ALIGN to 8
545	    // bytes (the per-CTA slice fronts an int64 row_off64 staging array; kVitTotalElems
546	    // is odd so sam_grad+total lands on an odd float offset → an int64 read there is
547	    // misaligned). Round up to the next even float. Unused unless Opt==SuperGrok2.
548	    float* sg2_ws_base = sam_grad + kVitTotalElems;
549	    if (((uintptr_t)sg2_ws_base & 0x7) != 0) sg2_ws_base += 1;   // → 8-byte aligned
550	    (void)sg2_ws_base;   // referenced only by the SuperGrok2 P3-SG2 phase
551	
552	    vittc::VitActs acts = vittc::vit_acts_bind(acts_base, T, B);
553	    vittc::VitTileScratch sc = vittc::vit_tile_scratch_bind(scratch_base + (int64_t)cta * scratch_per);
554	    float* my_lnvec = lnvec_base + (int64_t)cta * vittc::kLnVecElems;
555	
556	    VitWeights w = vit_bind(params);
557	
558	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's LN-vec partials + loss slot (dW/cls/pos/patch grads
559	    //    are written-once → no pre-zero). ──
560	    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < vittc::kLnVecElems; i += blockDim.x) my_lnvec[i] = 0.0f;
561	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
562	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots: INTEGRATION-OPTSTAGES.md §1 REQUIRES
563	    // prodigy_partials + prodigy_d zero-initialized before launch (the owner-computes
564	    // tree reads EVERY slot in ascending order; a CTA that claims no tensor in phaseA
565	    // still has its (r,s) slot read, and the persistent device workspace is NOT
566	    // re-zeroed between launches — so a stale slot from a prior step's reduction, or
567	    // garbage from the caching allocator, would make the cross-tensor d non-determi-
568	    // nistic / NaN). phaseA's block_reduce DOES write each slot, but zeroing here is
569	    // the contract guarantee + defends the prodigy_d broadcast slot. Guarded to the
570	    // Prodigy instantiation so every other cell is byte-identical (no extra work).
571	    if constexpr (Opt == OptId::Prodigy) {
572	        const int64_t n_opt = vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);   // 2*nCTA + 1
573	        for (int64_t i = (int64_t)cta * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n_opt;
574	             i += (int64_t)nCTA * blockDim.x)
575	            opt_reduce[i] = 0.0f;
576	    }
577	    bar.sync();   // B0
578	
579	    // ── P1: token-tile-parallel fwd+bwd. Each CTA grid-strides over (sub-)tiles
580	    //    of kVitP1SubtileRows rows; for its tile it runs fwd (→ acts X, NLL) then
581	    //    bwd (→ acts dY, dh0, LN-vec partials). Barrier-free within the tile. The
582	    //    B1 load-imbalance knob (SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_SUBTILE_S) sets the sub-tile to S
583	    //    whole samples (kSeq·S rows): S=64 ⇒ kVitP1SubtileRows==kTileM==1088 ⇒
584	    //    this loop is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the whole-1088-tile schedule (n_tiles=16
585	    //    at B=1024); S<64 grows n_tiles ~64/S× so the idle CTAs (116/132 at B1024)
586	    //    pick up P1 work and the B1 spin collapses. The tile boundary stays a
587	    //    whole-sample boundary (attention stays in-tile). ──
588	    const int nrows_tile = vittc::kVitP1SubtileRows;
589	    const int n_tiles = (T + nrows_tile - 1) / nrows_tile;
590	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;
591	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
592	    unsigned long long prof_fwd = 0, prof_bwd = 0;
593	#endif
594	    for (int ti = cta; ti < n_tiles; ti += nCTA) {
595	        const int g0 = ti * nrows_tile;
596	        const int nrows = (T - g0) < nrows_tile ? (T - g0) : nrows_tile;
597	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
598	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c0 = clock64();
599	#endif
600	        float nll = vittc::vittc_forward_tile(w, g0, nrows, acts, sc, in.patches, in.targets,
601	                                              sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
602	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
603	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c1 = clock64();
604	#endif
605	        vittc::vittc_backward_tile(w, g0, nrows, B, acts, sc, in.targets,
606	                                   my_lnvec, sc.work2, sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
607	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
608	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c2 = clock64();
609	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) { prof_fwd += _c1 - _c0; prof_bwd += _c2 - _c1; }
610	#endif
611	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;
612	        __syncthreads();
613	    }
614	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
615	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
616	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
617	        atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[0], prof_fwd);
618	        atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[1], prof_bwd);
619	    }
620	    unsigned long long _b1a = (threadIdx.x == 0) ? clock64() : 0;
621	#endif
622	    bar.sync();   // B1: all acts (X + dY) + LN-vec partials complete
623	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
624	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) { unsigned long long _b1b = clock64(); atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[2], _b1b - _b1a); }
625	#endif
626	
627	    // ── P2: assemble all 32 grads into `grad`. dW output-stationary (gt % nCTA),
628	    //    biases, cls/pos owner-scan, LN-vec reduce. No partials. The 10 dW specs
629	    //    are built into SHARED smem (thread 0; identical for all). ──
630	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) vittc::vittc_build_dw_specs(acts, B, T, Tp, sm.spec);
631	    __syncthreads();
632	    vittc::VitDwSpec* spec = sm.spec;
633	    const int n_dw = vittc::vittc_dw_total_tiles<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec);
634	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
635	    __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _dwa = (threadIdx.x == 0) ? clock64() : 0;
636	#endif
637	    if (kDwG > 1) {
638	        // SPLIT-K (multi-CTA tiling): fan (n_dw·G) (tile,chunk) partials over the
639	        // grid so the ~60% idle SMs do work; deterministic ascending-chunk reduce.
640	        for (int item = cta; item < n_dw * kDwG; item += nCTA) {
641	            const int gt = item / kDwG, kc = item % kDwG;
642	            vittc::vittc_dw_run_tile_splitk<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, gt, kc, kDwG, acts.dh0, dw_part, sm.sA, sm.sB);
643	        }
644	        bar.sync();   // all (gt,kc) partials complete before the reduce reads them

270	//  HBM bf16 ACTS buffer (Fork B). Carved from the FRONT of the workspace the
271	//  host allocates. Reinterpreted as __nv_bfloat16. All regions row-major
272	//  [rows × width]. Offsets are RUNTIME (depend on T = B*kSeq and B), computed
273	//  by vit_acts_bind. The struct holds base pointers per region.
274	//
275	//  ViT ADDS X_patch (the float→bf16 patch input the patch_proj dW reads) and
276	//  REPLACES the decoder's tok/pos embedding adjoint plumbing with dh0 (the
277	//  post-cat, pre-pos grad) whose CLS rows feed cls_token and whose patch rows
278	//  feed patch_proj; pos is Σ over all rows by position.
279	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
280	struct VitActs {
281	    // Patch-proj input (the image patches as bf16, laid out as PATCH token rows
282	    // [Tp, kPatch] where Tp = nsamp*kNPatch — patch_proj dW = dh0_patch^T @ this):
283	    __nv_bfloat16* X_patch;               // [Tp, kPatch]
284	    // Per-layer linear INPUTS X (needed by dW = dY^T @ X):
285	    __nv_bfloat16* X_in[vit::kLayers];    // [T, d]    in_proj input (= layer input)
286	    __nv_bfloat16* X_ctx[vit::kLayers];   // [T, d]    out_proj input (attn context)
287	    __nv_bfloat16* X_x1[vit::kLayers];    // [T, d]    ff0 input (n1 output)
288	    __nv_bfloat16* X_gact[vit::kLayers];  // [T, dff]  ff2 input (gelu output)
289	    // Per-layer linear OUTPUT adjoints dY (needed by dW + bias db = Σ_t dY):
290	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_qkv[vit::kLayers];  // [T, 3d]   in_proj output adjoint
291	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_a[vit::kLayers];    // [T, d]    out_proj output adjoint
292	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ff0[vit::kLayers];  // [T, dff]  ff0 output adjoint
293	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ff2[vit::kLayers];  // [T, d]    ff2 output adjoint
294	    // Head (B rows — CLS position only):
295	    __nv_bfloat16* X_hn;                  // [B, d]    head input
296	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_logits;             // [B, V]    head output adjoint (dlogits)
297	    // Embedding-input adjoint (post-cat, pre-pos): cls/patch/pos owners read it:
298	    __nv_bfloat16* dh0;                   // [T, d]
299	};

301	__device__ __forceinline__ VitActs vit_acts_bind(__nv_bfloat16* p, int T, int B) {
302	    VitActs a;
303	    int64_t off = 0;
304	    const int Tp = (T / vit::kSeq) * vit::kNPatch;
305	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * vit::kD;
306	    const int64_t T3d = (int64_t)T * 3 * vit::kD;
307	    const int64_t Tff = (int64_t)T * vit::kDff;
308	    a.X_patch = p + off; off += (int64_t)Tp * vit::kPatch;
309	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) {
310	        a.X_in[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
311	        a.X_ctx[li]  = p + off; off += Td;
312	        a.X_x1[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
313	        a.X_gact[li] = p + off; off += Tff;
314	        a.dY_qkv[li] = p + off; off += T3d;
315	        a.dY_a[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
316	        a.dY_ff0[li] = p + off; off += Tff;
317	        a.dY_ff2[li] = p + off; off += Td;
318	    }
319	    a.X_hn      = p + off; off += (int64_t)B * vit::kD;
320	    a.dY_logits = p + off; off += (int64_t)B * vit::kVocab;
321	    a.dh0       = p + off; off += Td;
322	    return a;
323	}

327	    const int64_t d = vit::kD, dff = vit::kDff, V = vit::kVocab, L = vit::kLayers;

337	//  Canonical Major-K smem stager (LIFTED verbatim from the decoder TC twin —
338	//  the wgmma engine is model-agnostic). Writes ONE MN×16 tile in the CUTLASS
339	//  Major-K INTERLEAVE layout (wgmma.cuh):
340	//      idx(mn,k) = (k/8)*(MN*8) + mn*8 + (k%8)
341	//  pulling element (mn, k) from a caller accessor `src(mn, kbase + k)`. Routing
342	//  the source axis through the accessor lets the SAME wgmma issue (TransA=0/
343	//  TransB=0, the substrate-validated orientation) serve fwd / dX / dW.
344	//  Cooperative over `nthreads` threads starting at thread `t0`.
345	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
346	template <int MN, typename Src>
347	__device__ __forceinline__ void stage_kmajor_tile(
348	        __nv_bfloat16* smem_tile, int kbase, Src src, int t0, int nthreads) {
349	    #pragma unroll 1
350	    for (int i = t0; i < MN * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK; i += nthreads) {
351	        const int mn = i / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
352	        const int k  = i % wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
353	        const int dst = (k >> 3) * (MN * 8) + mn * 8 + (k & 7);
354	        smem_tile[dst] = src(mn, kbase + k);
355	    }
356	}

358	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
359	//  Unpipelined single-CTA batch GEMM: D[M,N] = Σ_k A[m,k]·B[n,k], bf16 operands
360	//  (accessor-sourced + Major-K staged), fp32 accumulator, ascending-k. LIFTED
361	//  verbatim from the decoder TC twin (the engine is model-agnostic; only the
362	//  MaxAtomsM bound differs at the call sites — ViT's token tile is 17 atoms).
363	//
364	//  This helper computes ONE M-block of `m_atoms` stacked m64 atoms (rows
365	//  [mbase0, mbase0 + m_atoms*64)) for ONE N-tile of the compile-time atom width
366	//  N. The CALLER loops M-atom-blocks × N-tiles to cover arbitrary (M, N).
367	//  MaxAtomsM bounds the register accumulator array (compile-time); only
368	//  `m_atoms` (<= MaxAtomsM) atoms are issued at runtime. `n_real <= N` marks
369	//  the valid column count for a ragged N-tile (pad operands are zero → inert).
370	//
371	//  Determinism: ascending-k, one CTA owns the tile end-to-end, no atomics.
372	//
373	//  M-ROW GUARD (`m_real`, the SHARED B1-subtile fix): for ANY P1 sub-tile of
374	//  fewer than kSamplesPerTile whole samples the row count kSeq·S is NOT a
375	//  multiple of 64, so m_atoms = ceil(rows/64) pads the M-dim. Without a guard
376	//  srcA is read for ALL m_atoms*64 rows (the pad rows read into the NEXT tile's
377	//  acts region — a cross-CTA read-before-write — and the last sub-tile reads
378	//  past T), while `out` is gated only by col<n_real. `m_real` (the real row
379	//  count, relative to mbase0==0 for the P1 callers) makes pad-row srcA reads
380	//  return 0 and pad-row `out` writes skip → both the race and the over-read are
381	//  eliminated cleanly. CRITICAL: this engine is SHARED with the dW (P2) callers
382	//  and (at S==64) every P1 caller. The guard is gated on SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_SUBTILE_S
383	//  < 64 so when the knob is OFF the parameter and both guard sites VANISH from
384	//  the source — every existing caller (and the byte-identical S=64 build)
385	//  compiles EXACTLY as before. When ON, the P1 wrappers pass m_real = real rows;
386	//  the dW callers (which already self-guard `out` with m<Nout and read a
387	//  transposed-K operand, not row-padded acts) would pass m_real = m_atoms*64 ⇒
388	//  no-op — but they are never recompiled with the guard active in practice since
389	//  only P1 wrappers add the parameter (see vittc_gemm_* below).
390	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
391	#if SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_SUBTILE_S < 64
392	  // knob ON: real M-row guard threaded from the P1 wrappers
393	  #define SG_VIT_GEMM_MREAL_PARAM      , int m_real
394	  #define SG_VIT_GEMM_SRCA(r, kk)      (((r) < m_real) ? srcA((r), (kk)) : __float2bfloat16(0.f))
395	  #define SG_VIT_GEMM_OUTVALID(rr)     (col < n_real && ((rr)) < m_real)
396	#else
397	  // knob OFF (default S=64): guard erased → byte-identical to the pre-knob engine
398	  #define SG_VIT_GEMM_MREAL_PARAM
399	  #define SG_VIT_GEMM_SRCA(r, kk)      srcA((r), (kk))
400	  #define SG_VIT_GEMM_OUTVALID(rr)     (col < n_real)
401	#endif
402	template <int N, int MaxAtomsM, typename SrcA, typename SrcB, typename Out>
403	__device__ void tc_gemm_block_unpipelined(
404	        int mbase0, int m_atoms, int n_real, int k_steps SG_VIT_GEMM_MREAL_PARAM,
405	        SrcA srcA, SrcB srcB, Out out,
406	        __nv_bfloat16* smemA, __nv_bfloat16* smemB) {
407	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 900)
408	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
409	    const int nthreads = blockDim.x;            // 256
410	    const bool in_wg0 = (tid < 128);
411	    const int tid_wg = tid & 127;
412	
413	    // ── M-ATOM-INTERLEAVED wgmma pipeline (task #24, the decoder H1 win ported to
414	    //    the ViT twin). The OLD body ran each stacked m64 atom's k-chain to
415	    //    completion SEQUENTIALLY into ONE reused accumulator (atom0 chain → atom0
416	    //    store → atom1 chain → …), re-staging the shared B (operand) tile ONCE PER
417	    //    ATOM. (That single-accumulator form was itself a codegen fix: the original
418	    //    `WgmmaAccum<N> acc[MaxAtomsM]` indexed by the runtime atom `a` placed the
419	    //    17-wide ViT array in LOCAL memory — 5024 B stack — and serialized every
420	    //    wgmma via C7515 round-trips. A single register-resident accumulator removed
421	    //    that; but it also re-staged B per atom and left the MMAs back-to-back-
422	    //    serialized within the same fp32 fragment.)
423	    //
424	    //    Here atoms are processed in GROUPS of kIL (= min(MaxAtomsM, kVitMaxIL),
425	    //    compile-time, default 2). Within a group each k-step stages the kIL A-tiles
426	    //    (atom-in-group ai at smemA + ai·kVitTcSmemA1) + ONE shared B-tile, then
427	    //    issues the kIL wgmmas (one per atom) BACK-TO-BACK into their OWN fp32
428	    //    fragments before the single per-k wait. Two wins: (1) the kIL atoms are
429	    //    INDEPENDENT (distinct M-rows / accumulators) → the tensor pipe overlaps
430	    //    their MMA execution instead of paying each latency raw; (2) the B-tile is
431	    //    staged ONCE per group instead of kIL times → the (HBM-bound) operand
432	    //    traffic drops kIL×. kIL stays CAPPED at 2 so the accumulator array
433	    //    `acc[kIL]` (= kIL·N/2 fp32 regs) is register-resident (NOT the spilling
434	    //    17-wide array) and ptxas can address it (compile-time unrolled). Per-atom
435	    //    accumulation stays ASCENDING-k (k=0 ScaleD=0 overwrite, k>0 ScaleD=1 add)
436	    //    → numerics bit-identical + A/A/A determinism UNCHANGED. (Unpipelined: this
437	    //    engine has no S-stage ring; the win is purely the within-group overlap +
438	    //    B-staging-sharing.)
439	    constexpr int kIL = (MaxAtomsM < kVitMaxIL) ? MaxAtomsM : kVitMaxIL;
440	    #pragma unroll 1
441	    for (int g0 = 0; g0 < m_atoms; g0 += kIL) {
442	        const int gbase = mbase0 + g0 * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
443	        const int g_atoms = (m_atoms - g0) < kIL ? (m_atoms - g0) : kIL;
444	        wgs::WgmmaAccum<N> acc[kIL];            // kIL live fragments per group
445	        if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_fence();
446	        #pragma unroll 1
447	        for (int k = 0; k < k_steps; ++k) {
448	            #pragma unroll
449	            for (int ai = 0; ai < kIL; ++ai) {
450	                if (ai >= g_atoms) break;
451	                const int mbase = gbase + ai * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
452	                stage_kmajor_tile<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM>(
453	                    smemA + (int64_t)ai * kVitTcSmemA1, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
454	                    [&] (int mn, int kk) { return SG_VIT_GEMM_SRCA(mbase + mn, kk); },
455	                    tid, nthreads);
456	            }
457	            stage_kmajor_tile<N>(
458	                smemB, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
459	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcB(mn, kk); },
460	                tid, nthreads);
461	            __syncthreads();   // staged tiles visible to the whole CTA
462	            if (in_wg0) {
463	                wgs::SmemDesc dB = wgs::make_desc_B_kmajor<N, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(smemB);
464	                #pragma unroll
465	                for (int ai = 0; ai < kIL; ++ai) {
466	                    if (ai >= g_atoms) break;
467	                    wgs::SmemDesc dA = wgs::make_desc_A_kmajor<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(
468	                        smemA + (int64_t)ai * kVitTcSmemA1);
469	                    if (k == 0)
470	                        wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/0, 0, 0>(acc[ai], dA, dB);
471	                    else
472	                        wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/1, 0, 0>(acc[ai], dA, dB);
473	                }
474	                wgs::wgmma_commit_group();
475	                wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();
476	            }
477	            __syncthreads();   // MMAs done reading smem before next stage overwrites
478	        }
479	        if (in_wg0) {
480	            #pragma unroll
481	            for (int ai = 0; ai < kIL; ++ai) {
482	                if (ai >= g_atoms) break;
483	                const int mbase = gbase + ai * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
484	                #pragma unroll
485	                for (int i = 0; i < wgs::WgmmaAccum<N>::kRegs; ++i) {
486	                    int row, col;
487	                    wgs::wgmma_frag_decode(tid_wg, i, N, row, col);
488	                    if (SG_VIT_GEMM_OUTVALID(mbase + row)) out(mbase + row, col, acc[ai].c[i]);
489	                }
490	            }
491	        }
492	        __syncthreads();
493	    }
494	#else
495	    (void)mbase0; (void)m_atoms; (void)n_real; (void)k_steps;
496	    (void)srcA; (void)srcB; (void)out; (void)smemA; (void)smemB;
497	  #if SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_SUBTILE_S < 64
498	    (void)m_real;
499	  #endif
500	#endif
501	}

268	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.

276	
277	    // ── P3: the REAL optimizer tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 28
278	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──
279	    st.lr = lr;
280	    {
281	        __shared__ int task_slot;
282	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
283	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
284	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {

286	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
287	            const FusedOptState ts = mamba_rebase_state<Opt>(st, off);

291	                apply_optimizer<Opt>(p, gg, (int64_t)i, step, ts);

296	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
297	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
298	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the Mamba footprint requires
299	//    (exactly as launch_fused_vit_megakernel does):
300	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, kMambaSmemBytes)
301	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes in the occ≥1 query
302	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes at <<<...>>>
303	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
304	template <OptId Opt>
305	cudaError_t launch_fused_mamba_megakernel(
306	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, MambaTokenCtx tok,
307	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
308	    int dev = 0;
309	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
310	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
311	    int n_sms = 0;
312	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
313	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
314	
315	    const int dyn_smem = (int)kMambaSmemBytes;   // 145124 B (≈141.72 KB)
316	
317	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
318	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
319	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
320	        (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>,
321	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
322	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
323	
324	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
325	    int occ = 0;
326	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
327	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
328	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
329	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
330	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
331	    // satisfied. ~141.72 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 ~227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
332	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
333	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
334	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
335	           "fused_mamba_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The "
336	           "Mamba per-sample smem (~142KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
337	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
338	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
339	
340	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
341	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
342	
343	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
344	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
345	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
346	
347	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
348	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
349	    fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
350	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st);
351	    return cudaGetLastError();
352	}

407	// ── Static smem arena. The M-atom-interleaved wgmma pipeline (task #24, decoder
408	//    H1+H3 port) stages kMbAtomsPerSlot A(64×16) tiles per ring slot (one per
409	//    stacked m64 atom in an interleave GROUP, issued back-to-back into independent
410	//    fp32 fragments so the tensor pipe overlaps them; slot s, atom-in-group ai at
411	//    sA + (s*kMbAtomsPerSlot + ai)*64*16) + ONE shared B(N×16) tile per slot (slot s
412	//    at sB + s*N*16). kMbAtomsPerSlot = min(kAtomsM, kMbMaxIL) (fwd/dX = 2; dW = 2).
413	//    Plus the 256-float reduction slot + the scan-bwd cross-channel reduce targets
414	//    (dBmat/dCmat, [kSeq×kState] each) + the 8 dW specs (shared, not per-thread
415	//    stack). At S=2 + =2 + N=128 the ring is 2·(2·2KB+4KB)=16KB; MbTcSmem total
416	//    ~16.6KB ≪ the 48KB static cap (the TC launcher uses static smem). ──
417	struct MbTcSmem {
418	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[mbtc::kMbTcStages * mbtc::kMbAtomsPerSlot * 64 * 16];
419	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[mbtc::kMbTcStages * SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
420	    float red[256];
421	    float dBmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
422	    float dCmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
423	    mbtc::MbDwSpec spec[8];
424	};

441	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). Mirrors the
442	// decoder's dec_tc_opt_reduce_floats: the Prodigy P2.6 stage publishes per-CTA (r,s)
443	// slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d broadcast slot (1) — an owner-computes tree
444	// (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST nCTA (one
445	// CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 ≈ 1 KB) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so the opt-

447	// P3 never touches this region), so adding it leaves those cells byte-identical.
448	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
449	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]

451	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the Mamba twin of
452	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats. The SAM step perturbs p in place, runs a
453	//    SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for the exact restore (eager
454	//    clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-reversible, so save — don't
455	//    subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so the 2nd backward does NOT
456	//    clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad reads both). Both are total-
457	//    sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir itself persists in the `extra`
458	//    state slice, bound by the cell). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kMambaTotalElems)
459	//    so the opt-agnostic launcher fits every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell
460	//    (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses
461	//    the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc, as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so
462	//    no extra here. ──
463	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_looksam_floats() {
464	    return (int64_t)2 * kMambaTotalElems;    // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
465	}
466	// ── Muon (STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz) per-matrix scratch — the Mamba twin of
467	//    the decoder's dec_tc_muon_floats / the vit's vit_tc_muon_floats. The NS chain runs ONE
468	//    2D weight at a time over all CTAs; the scratch holds X/A/AX/AAX/orth for the LARGEST 2D
469	//    weight + the per-CTA Frobenius-norm partials + inv_norm. The momentum buffer (muon_buf)
470	//    is NOT here — it PERSISTS across steps as optimizer state, bound to the m slice
471	//    (st.exp_avg). Largest mamba 2D weight: in_proj = 512×128 = 65536 numel; largest rows =
472	//    512 ⇒ A = 512×512 (mbtc::kMbMuonMaxNumel/kMbMuonMaxRows). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY (≈
473	//    4·65536 + 512² + nCTA + 1 floats ≈ 2 MB) so the opt-agnostic cached launcher workspace
474	//    fits every OptId; unused by every non-Muon cell (its P2.7/P3-2D branches are if-
475	//    constexpr'd out → byte-identical). ──
476	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_muon_floats(int nCTA) {
477	    // X + AX + AAX + orth (each maxNumel) + A (maxRows²) + nrm_partials(nCTA) + inv_norm(1)
478	    return (int64_t)4 * mbtc::kMbMuonMaxNumel
479	         + (int64_t)mbtc::kMbMuonMaxRows * mbtc::kMbMuonMaxRows
480	         + nCTA + 1;
481	}

483	//    twin of dec_sg2_ws_stride_floats / dec_tc_sg2_floats. The composed megakernel
484	//    reads the meta-net weights from HBM, so the only SG2 workspace is the per-CTA
485	//    meta-net scratch (sg2_ws_stride, sized for the LARGEST tensor — the 65536-element
486	//    in_proj weight — which bounds every tensor's intermediates + the in-kernel
487	//    segmented-sort key/idx/perm/unsort), PLUS a row_off64 staging prefix
488	//    (kMambaNumTensors int64 = 2*N floats — the adapter that builds SG2State.row_off
489	//    (const int64_t*) from the __constant__ int kMambaOffsets). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY
490	//    (carve-LAST) so the opt-agnostic cached launcher workspace fits every OptId;
491	//    unused by every non-SG2 cell (its P3-SG2 phase is if-constexpr'd out →
492	//    byte-identical). ──
493	using MbSG2Dims = SG2Dims<>;
494	// max(kMambaSizes), re-derived from the layout table (mamba3_layout.cuh) so the SAME
495	// SG2 tail is correctly sized at ANY ladder width — was a d=128-pinned 65536 (in_proj
496	// [512,128] at d=128, the per-CTA carve bound).
497	constexpr int kMbSG2Nmax = kMambaMaxTensorNumel;   // == mamba_layout_check::max_size()
498	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_sg2_ws_stride_floats() {
499	    return (int64_t)2 * kMambaNumTensors
500	         + sg2_ws_stride<MbSG2Dims>((int64_t)kMbSG2Nmax);
501	}
502	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_sg2_floats(int nCTA) {
503	    // +1 for the 8-byte realignment slack of sg2_ws_base (kMambaTotalElems is odd, so
504	    // the per-CTA int64 row_off64 prefix may need a +1 bump to land 8-byte aligned).
505	    return (int64_t)nCTA * mb_sg2_ws_stride_floats() + 1;
506	}
507	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int nCTA) {
508	    (void)T;
509	    // MAMBA-3 scalar design: the per-CTA partial is the FULL grad [total] (not the
510	    // acts + tile-scratch + dW-split + non-GEMM-partial of the old wgmma Fork-B).
511	    // Layout order MUST match the kernel's pointer derivations:
512	    //   [nCTA*total | loss(nCTA) | loss_out(1) | opt_reduce(2nCTA+1) |
513	    //    sam_backup+sam_grad(2*total) | muon | sg2 (| profiler)].
514	    return (int64_t)nCTA * kMambaTotalElems          // per-CTA FULL grad partial
515	         + nCTA + 1                                  // loss slots + reduced loss
516	         + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)             // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
517	         + mb_tc_looksam_floats()                    // SAM 2nd-bwd scratch [sam_backup|sam_grad]
518	         + mb_tc_muon_floats(nCTA)                   // Muon NS per-matrix scratch
519	         + mb_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA)                    // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch (carve-LAST)
520	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
521	         + (int64_t)nCTA * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS * 2 + 2  // phase-profiler (doubles=2 floats) + align pad
522	#endif
523	         ;
524	}

526	template <OptId Opt>
527	__global__ void SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS
528	fused_mamba_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
529	                          float* __restrict__ params,
530	                          MambaTokenCtx tok,
531	                          float* __restrict__ grad,
532	                          float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
533	    // MAMBA-3 design: the "TC" megakernel runs the VALIDATED scalar per-sample
534	    // fwd+bwd (model_stage_mamba3.cuh, mb_forward_sample/mb_backward_sample —
535	    // matched to the fp64 oracle to ~2e-6) batch-parallel into a per-CTA FULL-grad
536	    // partial, then a deterministic ascending-CTA reduce + the canonical optimizer
537	    // tail (incl. the SAM 2nd backward for looksam/SG/SG2). The Mamba-3 mixer is
538	    // scan-dominated (the projections are a tiny share of the wall), so the scalar
539	    // engine IS the production path; the wgmma-projection dW machinery is bypassed.
540	    // The per-sample MambaSampleSmem (~227 KB) lives in DYNAMIC smem (opt-in by the
541	    // launcher), exactly like the scalar Mamba megakernel.
542	    extern __shared__ char mamba_tc_smem_raw[];
543	    MambaSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<MambaSampleSmem*>(mamba_tc_smem_raw);
544	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
545	    constexpr bool kSamCoupled = (Opt == OptId::LookSAM || Opt == OptId::SuperGrok11 ||
546	                                  Opt == OptId::SuperGrok15 || Opt == OptId::SuperGrok2);
547	    (void)kSamCoupled;
548	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
549	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
550	    const int B = tok.B;
551	    const int T = B * mb::kSeq;
552	    (void)T;
553	
554	    // Workspace partition. The per-CTA partial is the FULL grad [total] (scalar
555	    // design), NOT the dW-output-stationary split + non-GEMM partial. acts/scratch/
556	    // dw_part are unused on this path (kept zero-width in mb_tc_workspace_floats).
557	    float* ws = tok.workspace;
558	    const int64_t total_p = kMambaTotalElems;
559	    float* part_base = ws;                                  // [nCTA * total]
560	    float* loss_part = part_base + (int64_t)nCTA * total_p; // [nCTA]
561	    float* loss_out  = loss_part + nCTA;                    // [1]
562	    float* dw_part   = loss_out + 1;                        // unused (kept for layout parity)
563	    (void)dw_part;
564	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy P2.6) cross-CTA reduce slots: [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
565	    // = 2*nCTA+1. Carved after the loss slot (dw_part is zero-width here).
566	    float* opt_reduce = loss_out + 1;
567	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (mamba has
568	    // NO Muon region — unlike the decoder/vit twins — so this follows opt_reduce; term
569	    // order matches mb_tc_workspace_floats). Carving it here keeps every prior region's
570	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical. Layout:
571	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
572	    float* sam_backup = opt_reduce + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
573	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kMambaTotalElems;
574	    // Muon NS per-matrix scratch, carved AFTER the LookSAM sam scratch (term order matches
575	    // mb_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST [before the optional profiler] keeps every
576	    // prior region's offset unchanged, so the already-green mamba cells are byte-identical).
577	    // Unused unless Opt==Muon. Layout (mirrors the decoder/vit twins):
578	    //   [muon_X | muon_AX | muon_AAX | muon_orth] (each kMbMuonMaxNumel)
579	    //   [muon_A (kMbMuonMaxRows²)] [nrm_partials (nCTA)] [inv_norm (1)]
580	    float* muon_base  = sam_grad + kMambaTotalElems;
581	    // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch, carved AFTER the Muon NS scratch (term order
582	    // matches mb_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST [before the optional profiler]
583	    // keeps every prior region's offset unchanged, so the already-green mamba cells are
584	    // byte-identical). Each CTA owns mb_sg2_ws_stride_floats() (row_off64 staging +
585	    // meta-net scratch). ALIGN to 8 bytes (even float offset): the per-CTA slice fronts
586	    // an int64 row_off64 staging array; kMambaTotalElems is odd so sam_grad+total lands
587	    // on an odd float offset (4-byte) → an int64 read there is misaligned. Round up to
588	    // the next even float (the carve reserves +1 slack). Unused unless Opt==SuperGrok2.
589	    float* sg2_ws_base = muon_base + mb_tc_muon_floats(nCTA);
590	    if (((uintptr_t)sg2_ws_base & 0x7) != 0) sg2_ws_base += 1;   // → 8-byte aligned
591	    (void)sg2_ws_base;   // referenced only by the SuperGrok2 P3-SG2 phase
592	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
593	    // 8-byte align the double accumulator: round the float offset up to an even
594	    // count so reinterpret_cast<double*> is aligned (past the SG2 scratch — the
595	    // phase-profiler is the LAST workspace term, mirroring mb_tc_workspace_floats).
596	    float* prof_f = sg2_ws_base + mb_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA);
597	    uintptr_t _pa = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(prof_f);
598	    if (_pa & 0x7u) prof_f = reinterpret_cast<float*>((_pa + 7u) & ~uintptr_t(7u));
599	    double* prof = reinterpret_cast<double*>(prof_f);   // [nCTA*SLOTS], host-zeroed
600	    long long _pt = 0;
601	#endif
602
